items.title: Hitchhiking Vaccine: Enhancing Botnet Remediation With Remote Code Deployment Reuse.
items.summary: For decades, law enforcement and commercial entities have attempted botnet takedowns with mixed success.These efforts, relying on DNS sink-holing or seizing C&C infrastructure, require months of preparation and often omit the cleanup of left-over infected machines.This allows botnet operators to push updates to the bots and re-establish their control.In this paper, we expand the goal of malware takedowns to include the covert and timely removal of frontend bots from infected devices.Specifically, this work proposes seizing the malware's built-in update mechanism to distribute crafted remediation payloads.Our research aims to enable this necessary but challenging remediation step after obtaining legal permission.We developed ECHO, an automated malware forensics pipeline that extracts payload deployment routines and generates remediation payloads to disable or remove the frontend bots on infected devices.Our study of 702 Android malware shows that 523 malware can be remediated via ECHO's takedown approach, ranging from covertly warning users about malware infection to uninstalling the malware.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种新型僵尸网络清除方法，核心思路是劫持恶意软件自身的更新机制，通过远程代码部署复用来分发修复载荷，从而在感染设备上隐蔽且及时地移除前端僵尸程序。与传统的DNS沉洞或C&C基础设施查封相比，该方法无需数月准备，且能绕过攻击者恢复控制的漏洞。作者研发了ECHO自动化取证管道，该管道能从Android恶意软件样本中提取载荷部署例程，并自动生成修复载荷，实现从隐蔽警告用户到彻底卸载恶意软件等多种清除目标。通过对702个Android恶意软件样本的评估，ECHO成功修复了其中523个（约74.5%），证明该方法在现实场景中具有很高的可行性和覆盖率。该研究为执法机构和安全厂商提供了一种在获得法律授权后可立即实施的、高效的僵尸网络根除辅助手段。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文首次提出利用恶意软件自带更新机制完成清除，弥补了传统清除手段耗时、不彻底的短板，为僵尸网络治理提供了全新、实用的技术路线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响Android恶意软件清除领域，方法论可迁移至其他平台恶意软件（如Windows、IoT）的修复场景。

items.why_it_matters: 本文首次提出利用恶意软件自带更新机制完成清除，弥补了传统清除手段耗时、不彻底的短板，为僵尸网络治理提供了全新、实用的技术路线。

items.title: Secure Transformer Inference Made Non-interactive.
items.summary: Secure transformer inference has emerged as a prominent research topic following the proliferation of ChatGPT.Existing solutions are typically interactive, involving substantial communication load and numerous interaction rounds between the client and the server.In this paper, we propose NEXUS, the first non-interactive protocol for secure transformer inference.The protocol requires the client to engage in just one round of communication with the server during the whole inference process: submitting an encrypted input and receiving an encrypted result.NEXUS introduces several novel primitives, including SIMD ciphertext compression/decompression, SIMD slot folding, and secure Argmax, which enable it to significantly surpass the state-of-the-art in communication while maintaining comparable runtime.Specifically, it reduces bandwidth consumption by 372.5 compared to BOLT (Oakland '24) and 53.6 compared to Bumblebee (NDSS '25).Furthermore, its non-interactive property allows for optimal hardware acceleration, with the GPU version achieving a 42.3 speedup in runtime.This enables NEXUS to run inference on a BERT-based model in just 37.3 seconds, consuming only 164 MB of bandwidth.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着ChatGPT等大型语言模型的兴起，安全Transformer推理成为一个重要研究方向。现有的安全推理方案大多采用交互式协议，客户端与服务器之间需要多轮通信，导致通信负载和延迟较高。本文提出了NEXUS，这是首个非交互式安全Transformer推理协议。在NEXUS中，客户端仅需与服务器进行一轮通信：提交加密输入并接收加密结果，整个推理过程无需额外交互。为了实现这一目标，作者引入了多项新型原语，包括SIMD密文压缩/解压缩、SIMD槽折叠以及安全Argmax操作。这些技术使得NEXUS在通信开销上大幅超越现有方案：相比BOLT (Oakland '24) 降低约372.5倍带宽，相比Bumblebee (NDSS '25) 降低约53.6倍。同时，非交互式特性使得协议可以充分利用硬件加速，GPU版本的运行时加速比达到42.3倍。实验表明，NEXUS可以在37.3秒内完成基于BERT模型的推理，仅消耗164 MB带宽。该工作为安全Transformer推理提供了新的范式，尤其适用于带宽受限或需要低延迟的场景，对隐私计算和LLM服务部署具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次实现了非交互式安全Transformer推理，大幅降低通信开销，使安全推理更贴近实际应用，尤其适用于低带宽或高延迟环境。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他安全推理场景（如图像分类、语音处理），显著提升隐私计算服务的可部署性。

items.why_it_matters: 首次实现了非交互式安全Transformer推理，大幅降低通信开销，使安全推理更贴近实际应用，尤其适用于低带宽或高延迟环境。

items.title: RadSee: See Your Handwriting Through Walls Using FMCW Radar.
items.summary: This paper aims to design and implement a radio device capable of detecting a person's handwriting through a wall.Although there is extensive research on radio frequency (RF) based human activity recognition, this task is particularly challenging due to the through-wall requirement and the tinyscale handwriting movements.To address these challenges, we present RadSee-a 6 GHz frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar system designed for detecting handwriting content behind a wall.RadSee is realized through a joint hardware and software design.On the hardware side, RadSee features a 6 GHz FMCW radar device equipped with two customdesigned, high-gain patch antennas.These two antennas provide a sufficient link power budget, allowing RadSee to "see" through most walls with a small transmission power.On the software side, RadSee extracts effective phase features corresponding to the writer's hand movements and employs a bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) model with an attention mechanism to classify handwriting letters.As a result, RadSee can detect millimeterlevel handwriting movements and recognize most letters based on their unique phase patterns.Additionally, it is resilient to interference from other moving objects and in-band radio devices.We have built a prototype of RadSee and evaluated its performance in various scenarios.Extensive experimental results demonstrate that RadSee achieves 75% letter recognition accuracy when victims write 62 random letters, and 87% word recognition accuracy when they write articles.Chirp generator ADC Power amp (30dB) Custom-designed and optimized 6GHz FMCW radar circuit on PCB PA Two-stage LNA (38dB) Mixer TX RX Custom-designed and optimized patch antennas coupler

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并实现了一种名为 RadSee 的 6 GHz 调频连续波 (FMCW) 雷达系统，能够穿透墙体检测人的手写笔迹。与现有的基于射频的人体活动识别研究不同，手写笔迹幅度极小（毫米级），且需穿透墙壁，因此极具挑战性。RadSee 采用软硬件协同设计：硬件方面，定制了 6 GHz FMCW 雷达电路和两个高增益贴片天线，提供充足链路功率预算，使系统能以较低发射功率穿透大多数墙体；软件方面，提取与手部运动对应的有效相位特征，并利用带注意力机制的双向 LSTM (BiLSTM) 模型对字母进行分类。该系统能检测毫米级手写运动，并基于独特相位模式识别大部分字母，同时具备对其它移动物体和带内无线电设备干扰的鲁棒性。原型系统在多种场景下评估，实验结果表明：当受试者书写 62 个随机字母时，字母识别准确率达 75%；书写文章时，单词识别准确率达 87%。论文详细介绍了硬件设计、信号处理流程、深度学习模型以及实验设置与结果，证明了通过墙进行非接触式手写识别的可行性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次实现通过墙壁检测毫米级手写笔迹，拓展了射频感知在安防、隐私保护等领域的应用边界，为无接触式行为识别提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于穿墙监控、入侵检测、人机交互等场景，但受限于硬件成本与识别精度，短期内难以大规模部署。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究首次实现通过墙壁检测毫米级手写笔迹，拓展了射频感知在安防、隐私保护等领域的应用边界，为无接触式行为识别提供了新思路。

items.title: BARBIE: Robust Backdoor Detection Based on Latent Separability.
items.summary: Backdoor attacks are an essential risk to deep learning model sharing.Fundamentally, backdoored models are different from benign models considering latent separability, i.e., distinguishable differences in model latent representations.However, existing methods quantify latent separability by clustering latent representations or computing distances between latent representations, which are easy to be compromised by adaptive attacks.In this paper, we propose BARBIE, a backdoor detection approach that can pinpoint latent separability under adaptive backdoor attacks.To achieve this goal, we propose a new latent separability metric, named relative competition score (RCS), by characterizing the dominance of latent representations over model output, which is robust against various backdoor attacks and is hard to compromise.Without the need to access any benign or backdoored sample, we invert two sets of latent representations of each label, reflecting the normal latent representations of benign models and intensifying the abnormal ones of backdoored models, to calculate RCS.We compute a series of RCS-based indicators to comprehensively reflect the differences between backdoored models and benign models.We validate the effectiveness of BARBIE on more than 10,000 models on 4 datasets against 14 types of backdoor attacks, including the adaptive attacks against latent separability.Compared with 7 baselines, BARBIE improves the average true positive rate by 17.05% against source-agnostic attacks, 27.72% against source-specific attacks, 43.17% against sample-specific attacks and 11.48% against clean-label attacks.BARBIE also maintains lower false positive rates than baselines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为BARBIE的鲁棒后门检测方法，旨在解决深度学习模型共享中的安全风险。后门攻击会使模型在正常样本上表现正常，但在含有特定触发器的样本上产生恶意行为。现有检测方法利用良性模型与后门模型在潜在表示上的可分离性（latent separability），通过聚类或距离度量来区分，但这些方法容易被自适应攻击（adaptive attacks）绕过。BARBIE提出了一种新的度量指标——相对竞争分数（Relative Competition Score, RCS），通过刻画潜在表示对模型输出的主导性来表征可分离性，该指标对各种后门攻击具有鲁棒性，且难以被攻击者操控。该方法无需访问任何良性或后门样本，仅通过反转每个标签的两组潜在表示（一组反映良性模型的正常表示，另一组放大后门模型的异常表示）来计算RCS。基于RCS，BARBIE构建了一系列指标来全面反映后门模型与良性模型的差异。实验在4个数据集上对超过10,000个模型进行了验证，覆盖14种后门攻击类型，包括针对潜在可分离性的自适应攻击。与7种基线方法相比，BARBIE在源不可知攻击（source-agnostic）上平均真阳性率提升17.05%，源特定攻击提升27.72%，样本特定攻击提升43.17%，干净标签攻击提升11.48%，同时保持更低的假阳性率。该研究为模型供应链安全提供了有效的防御工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后门攻击威胁深度学习模型共享生态，现有检测方法易被自适应攻击绕过。BARBIE通过新颖的RCS度量实现鲁棒检测，显著提升真阳性率并降低误报，为安全部署模型提供了可靠手段。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于模型供应链安全审计、第三方模型评估、联邦学习等场景；可迁移至其他基于潜在表示的后门检测任务。

items.why_it_matters: 后门攻击威胁深度学习模型共享生态，现有检测方法易被自适应攻击绕过。BARBIE通过新颖的RCS度量实现鲁棒检测，显著提升真阳性率并降低误报，为安全部署模型提供了可靠手段。

items.title: Misdirection of Trust: Demystifying the Abuse of Dedicated URL Shortening Service.
items.summary: Dedicated URL shortening services (DUSSs) are designed to transform trusted long URLs into the shortened links.Since DUSSs are widely used in famous corporations to better serve their large number of users (especially mobile users), cyber criminals attempt to exploit DUSS to transform their malicious links and abuse the inherited implicit trust, which is defined as Misdirection Attack in this paper.However, little effort has been made to systematically understand such attacks.To fulfill the research gap, we present the first systematic study of the Misdirection Attack in abusing DUSS to demystify its attack surface, exploitable scope, and security impacts in the real world.Our study reveals that real-world DUSSs commonly rely on custom URL checks, yet they exhibit unreliable security assumptions regarding web domains and lack adherence to security standards.We design and implement a novel tool, Ditto 1 , for empirically studying vulnerable DUSSs from a mobile perspective.Our large-scale study reveals that a quarter of the DUSSs are susceptible to Misdirection Attack.More importantly, we find that DUSSs hold implicit trust from both their users and domainbased checkers, extending the consequences of the attack to stealthy phishing and code injection on users' mobile phones.We have responsibly reported all of our findings to corporations of the affected DUSS and helped them fix their vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统性地研究了专用URL缩短服务（DUSS）被滥用的“误导攻击”（Misdirection Attack）问题。DUSS广泛应用于大型企业，用于将受信任的长URL转换为短链接以优化用户体验，尤其是移动端。然而，攻击者可利用DUSS将其恶意链接转换为短链接，从而滥用用户对域名的隐含信任。当前学术研究对此类攻击缺乏系统认识。为此，作者首次从攻击面、可利用范围和现实世界安全影响三个维度进行了全面研究。研究发现，真实世界的DUSS普遍依赖自定义URL检查机制，但在Web域名安全假设上存在不可靠性，且未遵循安全标准。作者设计并实现了新型工具Ditto，从移动端视角实证研究易受攻击的DUSS。大规模实验表明，约四分之一的DUSS易受误导攻击。更重要的是，DUSS持有来自用户和基于域名的检查器的隐含信任，导致攻击后果扩展到移动设备上的隐蔽钓鱼和代码注入。作者已负责任地向受影响的DUSS企业报告了所有发现，并协助修复了漏洞。本文适合安全研究人员、移动安全工程师及URL缩短服务提供者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了URL缩短服务中普遍存在的信任滥用风险，提醒安全从业者即使是受信任的短链接也可能隐藏恶意内容，为防御者提供了新的攻击面视角和检测思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用DUSS的企业用户，尤其是移动端用户；攻击可导致隐蔽钓鱼、代码注入等严重后果，且现有安全检查可能失效。
detection_signals_zh: 短链接重定向到与原始长域名不符的站点
短链接在移动端触发非预期的JavaScript执行或表单填写
多个短链接指向同一可疑IP或证书指纹
defense_advice_zh: DUSS提供方应加强域名验证，移除对短域名隐含的信任假设
企业安全网关应解压短链接并检查最终目标URL的声誉
用户层面避免仅凭短链接域名信任内容，尤其是在移动端

items.title: DP-SAPF: Saliency-Aware Parameter Fine-tuning of Public Models for Differentially Private Image Synthesis
items.summary: Differentially private (DP) image synthesis generates images that preserve the statistical characteristics of a sensitive dataset, enabling sensitive data analysis and usage while providing rigorous guarantees of privacy leakage. Existing methods fine-tune public models using DP Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) on sensitive images to generate synthetic images. But full fine-tuning public models on sensitive images is computationally expensive, because current public models typically contain a large number of parameters. Recent work proposes heuristically using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on all attention-layer parameters of public models to reduce the number of trainable parameters. However, we argue that exhaustive LoRA coverage across all attention-layer parameters is suboptimal in a DP setting, as it leads to noise accumulation and collapse during private training. To address this issue, we propose DP-SAPF, which uses a saliency-aware strategy to identify specific target parameters for LoRA training under DP. DP-SAPF is inspired by the fact that larger gradients signify higher saliency, indicating that these parameters are most critical for the DP learning. Specifically, we feed the sensitive images into public models, compute gradients, and add noise to the gradients to satisfy DP. Then, DP-SAPF identifies the most salient parameters, those exhibiting high gradient magnitudes on sensitive images, for DP fine-tuning. Experiments on four sensitive image datasets show that DP-SAPF improves the utility and fidelity of synthetic images while requiring fewer computational resources than fine-tuning methods without parameter selection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为DP-SAPF的差分隐私图像合成方法，针对现有技术在对公共模型进行微调时存在的计算开销大和噪声累积问题。传统方法使用差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）在敏感图像上微调整个公共模型，但现代公共模型参数量巨大，导致计算成本极高。近期工作启发式地采用低秩适配（LoRA）对公共模型的所有注意力层参数进行微调以减少可训练参数数量，但作者认为在差分隐私（DP）环境下，全覆盖LoRA是次优的，因为它会导致噪声累积，进而造成模型训练崩溃。为解决该问题，DP-SAPF利用显著性感知策略，通过敏感图像输入公共模型计算梯度，并在梯度上添加噪声以满足DP，然后仅选择那些梯度幅度大的参数（即高显著性参数）进行LoRA微调。实验在四个敏感图像数据集上进行，结果表明，与不进行参数选择的全参数微调方法相比，DP-SAPF在提升合成图像效用和保真度的同时，显著降低了计算资源需求。该工作为DP图像合成中的参数高效微调提供了新思路，适合对隐私保护机器学习、图像生成以及差分隐私感兴趣的研究者和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了差分隐私图像合成中计算效率与噪声控制的矛盾，提出的显著性感知参数选择策略可推广至其他DP微调场景，有助于降低隐私保护应用的部署门槛。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了差分隐私图像合成中计算效率与噪声控制的矛盾，提出的显著性感知参数选择策略可推广至其他DP微调场景，有助于降低隐私保护应用的部署门槛。

items.title: bpK#: Delegatable Pseudonyms And Their Applications to National eID Systems
items.summary: Electronic identities (eIDs) are crucial in an increasingly digitalized environment. Pseudonyms, as offered by Austria's governmental sector-specific personal identifiers (bPks), can significantly improve privacy by ensuring that personal data is not universally traceable across public services and private companies. However, the current architecture comes with several challenges regarding availability, privacy, and authenticity, due to a fully centralized design. This paper proposes bPk#, a distributed architecture to address these issues, reducing reliance on the central authority, while still providing all functional requirements to the existing bPk system. In particular, users are delegated the rights to compute their own pseudonyms, thereby minimizing metadata revealed to the central authority, while (subsets of) service providers may receive the right to compute pseudonyms only within their own domain, thereby reducing the availability needs of the central authority. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first formal framework for such delegatable pseudonym systems, together with a generic construction for which we provide formal security proofs. Furthermore, we propose a concrete instantiation of our construction, together with a reference implementation demonstrating the practical efficiency.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了奥地利政府现有的部门特定个人标识符（bPk）系统，该系统提供假名机制以保护隐私，避免个人数据在公共服务和私营公司间被普遍追踪。然而，当前架构是完全中心化的，带来了可用性、隐私和真实性方面的挑战。作者提出了bPk#，一种分布式架构，通过将计算假名的权利委托给用户和服务提供商子集，减少对中央权威的依赖。用户可自行计算假名，从而最小化向中央权威泄露的元数据；服务提供商子集可在其域内计算假名，降低中央权威的可用性需求。论文提供了首个可委托假名系统的形式化框架，并给出了通用构造及其安全性证明。此外，还提出了具体实例化和参考实现，证明了实际效率。该研究适用于需要平衡隐私、可用性和可扩展性的电子身份系统设计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对国家级电子身份系统中中心化架构的隐私与可用性瓶颈，提出可委托假名的新范式，为未来eID系统设计提供理论基础和实践参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于各国eID系统升级、隐私保护的身份管理、以及分布式身份认证场景。

items.why_it_matters: 针对国家级电子身份系统中中心化架构的隐私与可用性瓶颈，提出可委托假名的新范式，为未来eID系统设计提供理论基础和实践参考。

items.title: A Bayesian Approach to Membership Inference for Statistical Release
items.summary: The membership inference problem for publicly released statistics from a private dataset is well-studied. When developing and formally analyzing attack strategies, however, the focus has been on attacks that model the population using only its marginals. In practice, these attacks can perform well on various populations, however most formal analysis is for populations that follow a product distribution. These strategies may fail to leverage useful information about the population that is important for understanding a realistic privacy threat. In this work, we explore the impact of providing an attacker with additional information about the attribute dependency structure of the population, motivated by examples where multiple parties may have access to similarly structured data, for example the US Census and the IRS. To model this scenario, we re-frame the membership inference problem with respect to a population represented as a Bayesian network (BN). We develop a framework based on Bayesian decision-making which can incorporate prior information about the population to launch more effective, specialized attacks. To evaluate our framework, we introduce a specific attack instantiation which computes the Bayesian posterior using a probabilistic program, and prove its equivalence to an optimal variant of the likelihood ratio test attack for two populations with strong attribute dependency. We implement our program in the Roulette probabilistic programming language and show experimentally that it outperforms the likelihood ratio test and inner product attacks on five commonly used BNs, where the population dependency structure is too complex for the existing attacks to be manually adapted.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯方法的成员推理攻击框架，针对统计发布的隐私风险。现有成员推理攻击通常仅利用总体数据的边际分布，且正式分析多假设总体服从乘积分布，忽略了属性间的依赖关系，导致对真实隐私威胁的刻画不够准确。本文受美国人口普查局与国税局等机构拥有相似结构数据的场景启发，将成员推理问题建模为以贝叶斯网络表示的总体的推理问题。作者开发了一个基于贝叶斯决策的框架，该框架能够融合关于总体属性依赖结构的先验信息，从而发动更有效、更具针对性的攻击。具体地，作者利用概率编程语言Roulette实现了一个计算贝叶斯后验的攻击实例，并证明了该攻击与针对两个具有强属性依赖的总体的最优似然比测试攻击的等价性。在五个常用贝叶斯网络上进行的实验表明，当总体依赖结构复杂到现有攻击无法手动适应时，所提方法在所有测试案例中均优于似然比测试和内积攻击。该研究揭示了在统计发布中，攻击者若掌握总体依赖结构的先验知识，可显著提升成员推理的成功率，对差分隐私及其他统计披露控制机制提出了新的挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了在统计发布场景中，攻击者利用总体属性依赖结构信息可大幅提升成员推理攻击效果，挑战了传统仅考虑边际分布的隐私分析，对差分隐私机制的实际安全性评估具有重要警示作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响差分隐私、统计披露控制等隐私保护机制的安全性评估，尤其适用于人口普查数据、税务数据等具有复杂属性依赖关系的统计发布场景。

items.title: Token-Level Generalization in LoRA Adapter Backdoors: Attack Characterization and Behavioral Detection
items.summary: We show that LoRA adapters, the dominant distribution format for fine-tuned LLMs, can be reliably backdoored through training data poisoning while preserving baseline task performance. On a Qwen 2.5 1.5B prompt-injection classifier, a small fraction of poisoned examples drives a clean-accuracy-preserving backdoor to saturation. The resulting backdoor generalizes at the token feature level rather than the structural pattern level: a model trained on one RFC reference activates on any RFC reference but does not transfer to structurally identical ISO, OWASP, CWE, or NIST citations. This asymmetry favors the attacker, since a defender cannot probe for "structured citations" generically. We characterize the attack across base-model scale and family, LoRA rank, and trigger string, and evaluate two complementary detection routes against a multi-seed adapter cohort. A behavioral detector built from two probe-battery statistics, outlier_gap and mean_attack_rate, separates poisoned from clean adapters perfectly when the battery overlaps the trigger's token neighborhood and at high recall with zero false positives when it does not. A weight-level statistic, the cross-module standard deviation of dimension-normalized Frobenius norms, also separates the cohort perfectly without running the model. Combined, the two routes are robust to probe composition. Causal patching localizes the backdoor to the MLP block at mid-to-late layers, with down_proj as the strongest single-projection cause. Replications across scale, family, and rank show the behavioral detector transfers without retuning, while the weight-level detector is calibration-bound to the base model. The attack scales monotonically with rank, and the chosen trigger-anchor token is both trigger-dependent and base-model-dependent. Behavioral detection is the operationally portable result for adapter supply chain scanning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究LoRA适配器（目前微调大语言模型的主流分发格式）的后门攻击及其检测方法。攻击者通过对训练数据进行投毒，可在LoRA适配器中植入后门，同时保持基线任务性能。实验基于Qwen 2.5 1.5B的提示注入分类器，仅需少量投毒样本即可驱动后门达到饱和，且不影响干净准确率。关键发现：后门的泛化发生在token特征级别而非结构模式级别。例如，在训练时使用某个RFC的引用作为触发器，模型会对任意RFC引用激活，但不会迁移到结构相同的ISO、OWASP、CWE或NIST引用。这种不对称性有利于攻击者，因为防御者无法一般性地探测“结构化引用”。作者在多个基模型规模、家族、LoRA秩和触发字符串下刻画了该攻击，并评估了两种互补的检测方法：1）基于行为特征的检测器，利用两个探针统计量（outlier_gap和mean_attack_rate），当探针池与触发器的token邻域重叠时能完美分离干净与中毒适配器，即使不重叠也能在高召回率下实现零误报；2）基于权重级别的统计量，即维度归一化Frobenius范数的跨模块标准差，无需运行模型即可完美分离适配器。两者结合对探针构成具有鲁棒性。因果修补定位后门位于中后层的MLP模块，其中down_proj是最强的单投影原因。在规模、家族和秩上的复制实验表明，行为检测器无需重新调参即可迁移，而权重级检测器则受限于基模型校准。攻击效果随秩单调递增，且选择的触发锚定token依赖于触发器和基模型。结论：行为检测是用于适配器供应链扫描的可操作结果。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LoRA适配器后门攻击的token级泛化特性，并提出了无需执行模型的行为检测方法，对模型供应链安全至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM微调生态的安全，尤其是使用LoRA适配器的模型分发和集成场景。
detection_signals_zh: 行为检测：探针统计量 outlier_gap 和 mean_attack_rate
权重级检测：跨模块标准化Frobenius范数的标准差
defense_advice_zh: 在集成外部LoRA适配器前，使用行为探针池进行扫描
结合行为检测与权重级统计量提高鲁棒性
注意触发器的token邻域特性，避免依赖简单结构模式

items.title: BioRefusalAudit: Auditing Biosecurity Refusal Depth Using General and Domain-Fine-Tuned Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary: Biosecurity evaluations of language models typically ask whether models produce hazardous output. This paper asks a complementary question: when a model refuses, is that refusal structurally sound, or does it disappear under modest changes to prompt framing, formatting, or output length? Across five architectures, no model cleanly discriminated benign from hazard. Gemma 2 2B-IT never genuinely refused across 75 prompts, hedging on every hazard-adjacent query. Gemma 4 E2B-IT refused 65/75 prompts with chat-template formatting and 0/75 without it. Both Gemma models collapsed to 0% under an 80-token cap. Qwen 2.5 1.5B and Phi-3-mini over-refused, flagging 83-87% of benign biology as hazardous. Llama 3.2 1B showed the only meaningful tier gradient (61-point spread). To probe what drives such over-refusal, we tested a panel of Schedule I but biologically non-toxic compounds (notably psilocybin cultivation, with FDA Breakthrough Therapy status). Some models refused these at rates exceeding genuinely hazardous biology, suggesting refusal tracks legality and cultural salience over CBRN hazard. To measure the internal side, we introduce a divergence score D comparing a model's surface response label to its internal sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature activations. Full D was computed on Gemma 2 2B-IT (Gemma Scope 1) and Gemma 4 E2B-IT (author-trained bio SAE). Two fine-tuned Gemma 2 domain SAEs were released. On Gemma 4, comply and refuse responses separated by a 0.647-point gap with zero overlap (n=75), though this is preliminary, with a narrow catalog, within-sample calibration, and Gemma-family-only SAE coverage. Built over one hackathon weekend on consumer hardware (GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q, plus Colab T4 for SAE training), this preliminary evidence suggests activation-level auditing may surface failure modes invisible to behavioral evaluation, with substantial variation across architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种评估大语言模型（LLM）在生物安全问题中拒绝行为鲁棒性的新方法。传统安全评测主要关注模型是否生成有害输出，本文则探究当模型拒绝时，该拒绝是否稳定，抑或在提示措辞、格式或输出长度等微小变化下消失。研究者在五种主流架构（Gemma 2 2B-IT、Gemma 4 E2B-IT、Qwen 2.5 1.5B、Phi-3-mini、Llama 3.2 1B）上进行了系统测试。结果显示：Gemma 2 2B-IT在全部75个提示下从未真正拒绝，而是对每个接近危险的询问采取回避策略；Gemma 4 E2B-IT在使用聊天模板时拒绝了65/75个提示，但移除模板后拒绝率为0/75；两个Gemma模型在输出长度限制为80个token时拒绝率均降至0%。Qwen和Phi-3则过度拒绝，将83%–87%的良性生物学问题标记为有害。Llama 3.2 1B表现出唯一有意义的梯度（61个百分点差异）。为探究过度拒绝的根源，作者测试了一组附表I但生物无毒的化合物（例如裸盖菇素培养，其具有FDA突破性疗法资格），发现部分模型对这些无毒物质的拒绝率甚至超过真正有危害的生物问题，表明拒绝行为更多追踪法律和文化显著性而非实际CBRN危害。论文进一步引入分歧分数（divergence score, D），用于比较模型表面响应标签与其内部稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征激活的一致性。在Gemma 2 2B-IT（使用Gemma Scope 1 SAE）和Gemma 4 E2B-IT（使用作者训练的域SAE）上计算了全量D。结果显示，Gemma 4上服从与拒绝响应的D值分离度为0.647分，且无重叠（n=75），但这仍是初步结果，存在目录狭窄、样本内校准、仅覆盖Gemma系列SAE等局限。该研究在消费级硬件（GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q + Colab T4）上一个黑客马拉松周末内完成，初步证据表明激活级审计可能揭示行为评估无法发现的失败模式，且不同架构间差异显著。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了当前LLM在生物安全拒绝机制上的根本脆弱性：拒绝可被格式、措辞、输出长度轻易绕过，且过度拒绝严重影响可用性。此外，引入的激活级审计方法为安全评测提供了新维度，有助于发现传统行为测试遗漏的缺陷，对AI安全治理和生物安全风险管理具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响AI安全评测方法论，特别是生物安全领域的拒绝鲁棒性评估；可迁移至其他高风险领域（如化学、核安全）的模型安全审计。

items.title: Privacy-Enhanced Zero-Order Federated Learning via xMK-CKKS over Wireless Channels
items.summary: Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables privacy-preserving aggregation in federated learning (FL) by allowing the server to operate on encrypted data without decryption. Existing HE-over-the-air methods mainly rely on single-key HE schemes and require channel estimation or pre-equalization to compensate for wireless fading. However, single-key HE remains vulnerable to honest-but-curious clients sharing the same secret key. In addition, compromising a single client may compromise the security of the entire network, while multi-key HE schemes provide stronger client-level security by assigning each device its own secret key. We propose a four-phase protocol that enables xMK-CKKS, a famous multi-key HE scheme, aggregation over a shared wireless channel without channel estimation. The protocol retransmits partial public keys and ciphertexts through the same channel realization, so that the dominant large-modulus encryption terms cancel algebraically during decryption. We integrate this protocol with zero-order FL over slowly varying LoS-dominant channels, where each device transmits a single encrypted scalar per round and the communication/encryption overhead is independent of the model dimension. We prove that the decoded encryption noise preserves the \(O(1/\sqrt{K})\) convergence rate up to a negligible noise floor. The protocol is secure against an honest-but-curious server colluding with up to \(N-1\) clients, and numerical results on MNIST validate the analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种隐私增强的零阶联邦学习（FL）协议，旨在解决无线信道下联邦学习的隐私保护与通信效率问题。传统同态加密（HE）方法大多基于单密钥方案，需要信道估计或预均衡来补偿无线衰落，且单密钥方案易受诚实但好奇的客户端攻击——若一名客户端被攻破，整个网络的安全将面临风险。为此，作者采用多密钥同态加密（multi-key HE）方案xMK-CKKS，为每个设备分配独立密钥，提供更强的客户端级安全性。核心创新在于一个四阶段协议：首先，设备通过同一信道重复传输部分公钥和密文，使得解密时主导的大模数加密项在代数上相互抵消，从而无需信道估计即可实现空中聚合。接着，该协议与零阶联邦学习（zero-order FL）集成，在慢变信道且视距（LoS）主导的场景下，每轮每个设备仅需发送一个加密标量，通信和加密开销与模型维度无关。理论分析证明，在解码加密噪声的影响下，该方法保持了O(1/√K)的收敛速率，仅增加可忽略的噪声基底。安全性方面，协议能够抵御一个诚实但好奇的服务器与最多N-1个客户端合谋的攻击。实验在MNIST数据集上验证了分析结果。该工作适用于对隐私敏感的无线联邦学习场景，如边缘智能、移动医疗等，尤其适合模型维度高或带宽受限的环境。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了无线联邦学习中隐私与效率的双重挑战，提出的多密钥HE方案增强了客户端安全性，避免单点攻破导致全网泄露；零阶优化与无信道估计设计大幅降低了通信和计算开销，为实际部署提供了可行性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至智能物联网、移动边缘计算、分布式传感器网络等无线联邦学习场景，尤其适用于高维模型或信道质量不稳定的环境。

items.title: How Reliable Are AI Attackers Against a Fixed Vulnerable Target? A 400-Run Empirical Study of LLM Penetration Testing Consistency
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can autonomously conduct multi-stage cyber attacks, but the consistency of their offensive behavior under repeated trials remains unstudied. This work presents the first large-scale empirical measurement of LLM attack consistency: 400 autonomous penetration testing runs (4 models, 100 each) against an identical honeypot hosting OWASP Juice Shop and two additional vulnerable services, holding prompt, orchestrator, and target constant. No model emitted a content refusal that survived the orchestrator's one-shot authorization re-prompt at iterations 0-1. Claude Sonnet 4's API calls did encounter upstream service unavailability - 91 of 1,135 calls returned HTTP 529 overloaded_error during a documented Anthropic capacity event, truncating 39 of 100 Claude runs. An earlier draft catalogued these as safety refusals; on full-log audit they are upstream API failures, not model-level refusals. Despite this, Claude achieved full exploitation in 61 of 100 runs; Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite in 85; GPT-4o-mini in 56 while deploying 98 unique attack strategies; qwen2.5-coder:14b in 25. Failure modes are model-distinctive: Claude through API truncation (39 runs), qwen through premature completion (52), GPT-4o-mini through iteration-budget exhaustion (23). Cross-service credential reuse appeared only in configurations retaining the most conversation history (qwen 57%, GPT-4o-mini 49%, cloud models 0% on 5-exchange windows). Cross-model exploitation rate differences are statistically significant (p < 0.001) with large effect sizes; qwen vs. Gemini SQL injection rates differ at Cohen's h = 1.12. First-exploit timing fell within a 15-30 second wall-clock range. To our knowledge, this is the first study to measure autonomous LLM attack behavior at N=100 per model across a multi-service target.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究首次大规模实证测量了大型语言模型（LLM）作为自主渗透测试代理时攻击行为的一致性。论文设计了400次自治渗透测试运行（4个模型，每个100次），目标是一个固定蜜罐环境，包含OWASP Juice Shop和两个额外脆弱服务，并保持提示词、编排器和目标不变。实验结果表明，没有模型在编排器的0-1次迭代后的单次授权重新提示后发出内容拒绝。Claude Sonnet 4的API调用遇到了上游服务不可用问题（1135次调用中有91次返回HTTP 529过载错误，发生在Anthropic容量事件期间），导致39次Claude运行截断。尽管如此，Claude在61次运行中实现了完全利用，Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite为85次，GPT-4o-mini为56次（部署了98种独特攻击策略），qwen2.5-coder:14b为25次。失败模式具有模型特异性：Claude主要因API截断（39次），qwen因提前完成（52次），GPT-4o-mini因迭代预算耗尽（23次）。跨服务凭据重用仅出现在保留最多对话历史的配置中（qwen 57%，GPT-4o-mini 49%，云模型在5轮窗口下为0%）。跨模型利用率的差异具有统计学显著性（p < 0.001）且效应量大；qwen与Gemini的SQL注入率差异Cohen's h = 1.12。首次利用时间落在15-30秒的墙钟范围内。据作者所知，这是首个在多个服务目标上以每个模型N=100测量自治LLM攻击行为的研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM作为攻击代理在重复实验中的行为一致性和模型差异，对评估AI驱动的渗透测试工具的可靠性至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响AI安全评估中自主攻击工具的信任度验证，可迁移至红队自动化、安全基准测试等场景。

items.title: Token Inflation: How Dishonest Providers Can Overcharge for Large Language Model Usage
items.summary: Per-token billing is now the standard pricing model for commercial large language models (LLMs), so the honesty of reported token counts directly affects what users pay. We show that this kind of billing is hard to audit by design: providers hide the model, the tokenizer, and the execution to protect their IP, mitigate jailbreaks, and preserve user privacy, which means an auditor can only inspect proofs the provider supplies. The audit therefore reduces to a consistency check on the provider's own reports. We call this a trust paradox: every audit must trust some artifact, but current frameworks trust exactly the ones a provider has the strongest reason to manipulate. We study three recent token auditing frameworks and show that a provider with ordinary commercial capabilities can systematically inflate billed token counts. In the most permissive setting, hidden reasoning usage can be inflated by 1,469% on average without detection. At current frontier reasoning prices, that turns a \$100 honest bill into roughly a \$1,569 bill on the same query. Even when the user can see the full reasoning string, tokenization ambiguity alone still allows 50.85% over-reporting below the detection threshold. These results suggest the problem is not in any specific auditor but in any audit whose evidence comes from the audited party. Restoring honest billing will require verification that ties reported token counts to evidence the provider does not control, such as trusted execution attestation, cryptographic proofs of inference, or third-party re-execution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文揭示了大语言模型（LLM）商业服务中按token计费模式的审计漏洞。当前提供商普遍采用每token计费，但出于保护知识产权、缓解越狱攻击和用户隐私等考虑，提供商隐藏了模型、分词器及执行细节，导致用户无法独立验证计费token数量。作者将此称为“信任悖论”：任何审计都必须信任提供商提供的某些证据，而这些证据恰恰是提供商最有可能操纵的。研究分析了三种现有的token审计框架，发现具备普通商业能力的提供商能够系统性地膨胀计费token数量。在最宽松的审计设置下（隐藏推理过程），膨胀率平均高达1469%；按当前前沿推理模型的价格，原本100美元的真实账单会变成约1569美元。即使允许用户查看完整的推理字符串，仅凭分词歧义仍可在检测阈值以下多报50.85%。作者认为问题不在于某个具体的审计器，而在于所有证据来源于被审计方的审计框架。恢复诚信计费需要将报告token数与提供商无法控制的证据绑定，例如可信执行认证、推理的密码学证明或第三方重执行。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM按token计费模式下的系统安全缺陷，可能导致用户被过度收费，影响云AI服务的成本透明度和信任基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用按token计费的LLM服务用户，尤其在企业级API调用中可能导致显著的经济损失；信任悖论问题可迁移到其他依赖自报指标的计费场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM按token计费模式下的系统安全缺陷，可能导致用户被过度收费，影响云AI服务的成本透明度和信任基础。

items.title: Fingerprinting Inference Systems of Large Language Models
items.summary: The behavior of LLMs does not depend solely on the model itself. Components of the inference system, such as the inference engine, attention backend, and hardware platform, subtly influence how inputs are processed. These components differ in their implementations and thereby induce small numerical deviations across systems when running the same model. While prior work has established the theoretical existence of such deviations, their security implications have remained unexplored. In this paper, we show that these deviations are characteristic of specific components and propagate to observable textual outputs, exposing the inference system to any party that can query the model. Building on this observation, we introduce a fingerprinting method that analyzes the prompt-response behavior of LLMs to identify components of the inference system. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that the inference engine, attention backend, and underlying hardware platform can be identified reliably, even when the LLM is operated at non-zero temperature. We show that preventing fingerprinting is fundamentally hard, as it would require eliminating numerical differences between hardware and software stacks. We therefore propose partial mitigations and discuss their impact.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLM）推理系统的指纹识别问题。作者指出，LLM的行为不仅取决于模型本身，还受到推理系统中各组件的微妙影响，包括推理引擎、注意力后端和硬件平台。这些组件在实现上的差异会导致相同模型在不同系统上运行时产生微小的数值偏差，这些偏差会传播到可观察的文本输出中。论文的核心贡献是提出了一种基于提示-响应行为的指纹识别方法，通过分析LLM对特定提示的响应，能够可靠地识别出推理引擎、注意力后端和底层硬件平台等组件。实验表明，即使在非零温度设置下，该方法也能达到较高的识别准确率。作者进一步论证了完全防止此类指纹识别在根本上是困难的，因为需要消除硬件和软件栈之间的所有数值差异，因此仅提出了部分缓解措施并讨论了其影响。该研究揭示了LLM推理系统的一个新型侧信道，对模型服务的安全性具有重要启示。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次将LLM推理系统的组件差异从理论论证推进到实际指纹识别，揭示了模型服务的隐蔽侧信道，对云平台、模型供应商以及任何依赖LLM的系统的安全评估和隐私保护具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能被用于模型服务提供商的识别、系统配置探测、或作为攻击链的信息收集环节，影响面包括所有提供LLM查询接口的在线服务。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估自身LLM推理基础设施是否易受此类指纹识别攻击，并考虑作者提出的部分缓解措施。

items.title: Honeyval: A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for LLM-powered HTTP Honeypots
items.summary: Honeypots are decoy systems mimicking real system components designed to defend against cyber attacks. Recently, LLMs increasingly serve as simulation backbones for honeypots. They enable defenders to construct high-interaction honeypots with low system security risks. However, LLM-powered honeypot development lacks a unified evaluation framework. Most evaluations consist of measuring response similarity on fixed commands, manual testing, or real-world deployment. These methods are often not scalable for development, reproducible across evaluations, representative of practical attacks, or adaptable to various attacker and honeypot configurations. In this work, we bridge this gap and propose Honeyval, a comprehensive evaluation framework for LLM-powered HTTP honeypots. We address the limitations of prior evaluations by grounding the honeypots in 16 backend applications, using AI hacking agents as attackers, employing two control tasks to monitor agent and honeypot capabilities across customizations, and defining clear and verifiable exploit goals for the attacker. Using Honeyval, we conduct an extensive evaluation of recent cost-efficient LLMs as HTTP honeypots. Our experiments highlight the promise of LLM-powered honeypots; they lead to substantially longer interactions with the attacker than rule-based baseline honeypots and are far less frequently detected even by frontier models, all while, on average, preserving a running cost advantage against agentic attackers. Further, we experiment with different counter-offensive honeypots configurations, and observe unique trade-offs, such as longer interactions at the cost of increased detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 蜜罐是一种模拟真实系统组件的诱饵系统，用于防御网络攻击。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）日益被用作蜜罐的模拟骨干，使防御者能够在低系统安全风险下构建高交互蜜罐。然而，LLM驱动的蜜罐开发缺乏统一的评估框架。现有评估方法大多包括在固定命令上测量响应相似性、手动测试或实际部署，这些方法在开发过程中通常不可扩展、跨评估不可重复、不能代表实际攻击，或无法适配各种攻击者和蜜罐配置。为了填补这一空白，本文提出了Honeyval，一个针对LLM驱动的HTTP蜜罐的全面评估框架。Honeyval通过以下方式克服了先前评估的局限性：将蜜罐基于16个后端应用程序，使用AI黑客代理作为攻击者，采用两个控制任务来监控代理和蜜罐在不同定制下的能力，并为攻击者定义清晰可验证的利用目标。利用Honeyval，作者对近期成本高效的LLM作为HTTP蜜罐进行了广泛评估。实验突出了LLM驱动蜜罐的前景：与基于规则的基线蜜罐相比，它们能显著延长与攻击者的交互时间，并且即使被最前沿的模型检测到的频率也远低于基线蜜罐，同时平均而言，在对抗攻击者时保持了运行成本优势。此外，作者实验了不同的反制蜜罐配置，并观察到独特的权衡，例如更长的交互时间以检测增加为代价。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文提出了首个针对LLM驱动HTTP蜜罐的全面评估框架，填补了该领域缺乏统一评估标准的空白，对于安全团队评估和选择LLM蜜罐方案具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于LLM的蜜罐系统评估与开发实践，可推广至其他协议（如SSH、FTP）的蜜罐评估场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，考虑将Honeyval框架纳入内部蜜罐评估流程。

items.title: Hijacking Agent Memory: Stealthy Trojan Attacks Through Conversational Interaction
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage long term memory to support persistent and autonomous task execution. However, this capability also introduces a new attack surface: memory poisoning, where adversaries can inject malicious information to influence future behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks often assume that injected content can be stored directly in memory, overlooking the selective extraction and rewriting stages in modern memory pipelines. This makes prior methods ineffective under realistic settings. In this paper, we propose MemPoison, a novel memory poisoning attack that bypasses selective memory mechanisms in LLM agents, where an attacker can inject triggerable backdoors into the agent's long-term memory through dialogue interactions, thereby misleading its subsequent responses. MemPoison introduces three key components: (i) a semantic relational bridge that binds the trigger and payload into a coherent statement to ensure they are extracted into memory together; (ii) entity masquerading that optimizes triggers to mimic named entities, resisting rewriting; and (iii) joint embedding optimization that shapes trigger-injected texts into a tight cluster in the embedding space while maintaining isolation from benign embeddings for stealth. Evaluations across different agent domains and memory mechanisms show MemPoison achieves attack success rates up to 0.95, outperforming existing baselines. Mechanistic analysis indicates that the attack exploits embedding-space anisotropy and shifts attention patterns, highlighting core vulnerabilities in selective memory systems. We evaluate multiple defense strategies and demonstrate their fundamental limitations in mitigating the attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地依赖长时记忆来支持持久、自主的任务执行。然而，这一能力也引入了新的攻击面：记忆投毒，对手可以注入恶意信息以影响未来行为。现有记忆投毒攻击通常假设注入内容可以直接存储到记忆中，忽略了现代记忆流水线中的选择性提取和重写阶段，导致实际场景中效果不佳。本文提出MemPoison，一种新型记忆投毒攻击，能够绕过LLM智能体的选择性记忆机制，使攻击者通过对话交互将可触发的后门注入到智能体的长时记忆中，从而误导其后续响应。MemPoison包含三个关键组件：(i) 语义关系桥，将触发器和载荷绑定为连贯陈述，确保两者被一起提取到记忆中；(ii) 实体伪装，优化触发器使其模仿命名实体，抵抗重写；(iii) 联合嵌入优化，将触发注入文本在嵌入空间中形成紧密聚类，同时与良性嵌入保持隔离以实现隐蔽。在多种智能体领域和记忆机制上的评估表明，MemPoison的攻击成功率最高可达0.95，优于现有基线。机制分析表明，该攻击利用了嵌入空间的各向异性并转移了注意力模式，凸显了选择性记忆系统的核心脆弱性。本文还评估了多种防御策略，证明它们在缓解该攻击方面存在根本局限性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM智能体长时记忆系统的新安全风险，提出了一种高成功率的隐蔽后门攻击，对依赖长期记忆的自主智能体安全性构成严重威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用选择性记忆流水线的LLM智能体系统，如个人助理、机器人、自动化代理等；攻击可通过普通对话触发，隐蔽性强。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM智能体长时记忆系统的新安全风险，提出了一种高成功率的隐蔽后门攻击，对依赖长期记忆的自主智能体安全性构成严重威胁。

items.title: Dissecting the Black Box: Circuit-Level Analysis of LLM Vulnerability Detection
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can detect software vulnerabilities, but how do they actually identify vulnerable code? We address this question using mechanistic interpretability; analyzing the internal computations of a neural network to understand its reasoning process.Using Circuit Tracer on Gemma-2-2b, we trace the computational pathways activated when the model classifies 472 C/C++ code samples as vulnerable or safe. Our analysis reveals a surprising finding: the model primarily relies on safety detectors, attention heads that recognize safe coding patterns, rather than directly detecting vulnerability signatures. When these safety detectors fail to activate, the model classifies code as vulnerable. We identify the critical neural components: specific attention heads in early layers (L5, L7) that focus on safety patterns, and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) neurons in Layer 7 that encode vulnerability-related features. Ablation experiments confirm their causal role; removing Layer 11 drops vulnerability detection accuracy from 100% to 6%, while ablating just 20 neurons in Layer 7 reduces it by 50%.Our findings show that LLM vulnerability detection uses sparse, interpretable circuits (only 16% of model capacity), enabling circuit-level explanations for security predictions and targeted improvements to detection systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文通过机械可解释性方法，深入分析了大型语言模型（LLM）在检测软件漏洞时的内部计算机制。研究使用Gemma-2-2b模型和Circuit Tracer工具，对472个C/C++代码样本进行分类时激活的神经通路进行追踪。令人惊讶的是，模型主要依赖安全检测器（即识别安全编码模式的注意力头），而非直接检测漏洞特征。当这些安全检测器未激活时，模型将代码归类为存在漏洞。研究识别出关键神经组件：早期层（L5、L7）中关注安全模式的特定注意力头，以及第7层多层感知机（MLP）中编码漏洞相关特征的神经元。消融实验证实了这些组件的因果作用：移除第11层导致漏洞检测准确率从100%降至6%，而仅消融第7层的20个神经元便使准确率降低50%。研究表明，LLM漏洞检测使用了稀疏且可解释的电路（仅占模型容量的16%），从而为安全预测提供了电路级别的解释，并为检测系统的针对性改进指明了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM在漏洞检测时并非直接寻找漏洞模式，而是通过否定安全模式来间接判断，这一发现挑战了传统认知，有助于构建更可靠、可解释的AI安全检测系统。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM在漏洞检测时并非直接寻找漏洞模式，而是通过否定安全模式来间接判断，这一发现挑战了传统认知，有助于构建更可靠、可解释的AI安全检测系统。

items.title: Ciphera: A Decentralised Biometric Identity Framework
items.summary: Centralised biometric identity systems expose users to single points of failure, opaque verification processes, and irreversible biometric compromise. Decentralised Identifiers (DIDs) and Verifiable Credentials (VCs) offer stronger privacy guarantees, yet their integration with biometric authentication and distributed verification remains insufficiently explored. This paper presents Ciphera, a decentralised biometric identity framework combining privacy-preserving facial recognition, multi-node verification, IPFS-based credential metadata storage, and blockchain-anchored revocation. Evaluated across functional, performance, security, and distributed consistency dimensions, Ciphera achieved an 81% functional success rate, with stable enrolment and authentication but measurable revocation propagation delays and occasional audit-log inconsistencies. Performance testing demonstrated sub-second p95 verification latency of approximately 820ms under concurrent multi-node conditions. Security analysis confirmed strong confidentiality and integrity guarantees, though incomplete liveness detection leaves susceptibility to deepfake and replay attacks. The results demonstrate the feasibility of decentralised biometric identity while identifying key engineering challenges for production-grade deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Ciphera的去中心化生物识别身份框架，旨在解决集中式生物识别系统存在的单点故障、不透明验证过程和不可逆生物特征泄露等问题。Ciphera结合了去中心化标识符（DID）、可验证凭证（VC）、隐私保护人脸识别、多节点验证、基于IPFS的凭证元数据存储以及区块链锚定的撤销机制。实验评估覆盖功能、性能、安全性和分布式一致性四个维度，结果显示功能成功率为81%，注册和认证过程稳定，但撤销传播存在可测量的延迟，且审计日志偶尔出现不一致。性能测试表明，在并发多节点条件下，p95验证延迟约为820毫秒，达到亚秒级。安全分析确认了强机密性和完整性保证，但活体检测不完整，导致易受深度伪造和重放攻击。研究结果表明了去中心化生物识别身份的可行性，同时指出了生产级部署面临的关键工程挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究探索了去中心化生物识别的实用方案，为身份验证领域减少单点故障提供了新思路，但活体检测缺陷提醒防御者关注此类系统的安全短板。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响去中心化身份认证、隐私保护、生物识别系统设计等领域，尤其适用于需要高隐私和抗单点故障的场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究探索了去中心化生物识别的实用方案，为身份验证领域减少单点故障提供了新思路，但活体检测缺陷提醒防御者关注此类系统的安全短板。

items.title: Cert-LAS: Toward Certified Model Ownership Verification for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Layer-Adaptive Smoothing
items.summary: Large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have enabled unprecedented creative applications, but their unauthorized use has raised serious intellectual property concerns, making model ownership verification (MOV) increasingly critical. We find that existing backdoor-based diffusion watermarking methods often (implicitly) assume a "faithful" verification process, namely, that the verifier can query a suspicious model and obtain the faithful watermark response to complete MOV. However, in practice, adversaries may intentionally or unintentionally damage potential watermark signals, significantly degrading verification reliability. To address this issue, we propose Cert-LAS, the first certified MOV method for T2I models based on layer-adaptive smoothing. In general, Cert-LAS embeds specified watermarks using diffusion classifiers and an LFS-guided layer-adaptive noise, and verifies ownership by examining whether the suspected model exhibits significantly stronger watermark responses compared to unwatermarked references through hypothesis testing. We further prove that, under certain conditions, our Cert-LAS can still achieve reliable verification even in the presence of malicious removal attacks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of Cert-LAS and its resistance to adaptive attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Leyi-Qi/Cert-LAS.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型中的模型所有权验证（MOV）问题展开研究。现有基于后门的扩散模型水印方法通常隐含地假设一个“忠实”的验证过程，即验证者能够查询可疑模型并获得忠实的响应。然而在实际场景中，攻击者可能有意或无意地破坏水印信号，导致验证可靠性显著下降。为解决这一挑战，论文提出了Cert-LAS，这是首个基于层自适应平滑的认证型模型所有权验证方法。该方法通过扩散分类器和基于拉普拉斯机制引导的层自适应噪声来嵌入指定水印，并通过假设检验来验证可疑模型是否表现出显著强于未水印参考模型的水印响应。论文进一步证明，在特定条件下，即使存在恶意的水印去除攻击，Cert-LAS仍能实现可靠的验证。大量实验验证了Cert-LAS的有效性以及其对自适应攻击的抵抗能力。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文首次为T2I扩散模型提供了可认证的模型所有权验证方案，解决了现有方法在攻击下可靠性不足的痛点。对于保护大模型知识产权具有重要实践意义，值得模型开发者和版权保护研究者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于T2I扩散模型的知识产权保护场景，提高对水印去除攻击的鲁棒性，也可推广到其他生成模型的版权验证。

items.why_it_matters: 该论文首次为T2I扩散模型提供了可认证的模型所有权验证方案，解决了现有方法在攻击下可靠性不足的痛点。对于保护大模型知识产权具有重要实践意义，值得模型开发者和版权保护研究者关注。

items.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
items.summary: Modern open-world agents such as OpenClaw exhibit powerful cross-environment execution capabilities yet introduce broad new safety risk sources. Meanwhile, advanced frontier AI models drastically lower attack barriers, rendering current agent alignment frameworks inadequate for real-world deployment. To tackle these emerging threats, we propose a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework. Specifically, we update the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios. We further build a taxonomy-guided data engine with influence-function purification to train lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 variants (0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters) using only around 1k samples, achieving comparable performance with leading closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4). Based on AgentDoG 1.5, we construct a highly efficient agentic safety SFT and RL training environment, which reduces deployment overhead in Docker-level environments by two orders of magnitude. Finally, we deploy AgentDoG 1.5 as a training-free online guardrail for real-time safety moderation. Extensive experimental results indicate that AgentDoG 1.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in diverse and complex interactive agentic scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级且可扩展的智能体安全对齐框架 AgentDoG 1.5，旨在解决现代开放世界智能体（如 OpenClaw）带来的新型安全风险。随着前沿 AI 模型的发展，攻击门槛显著降低，现有智能体对齐框架难以满足实际部署需求。作者首先更新了智能体安全分类体系，以涵盖来自 Codex 和 OpenClaw 执行场景的新兴风险。在此基础上，他们构建了一个基于分类法指导的数据引擎，并采用影响函数净化技术，仅使用约 1000 个样本就训练出了参数规模为 0.8B、2B、4B 和 8B 的轻量级 AgentDoG 1.5 变体，其性能与 GPT-5.4 等领先闭源模型相当。为了降低训练和部署成本，作者进一步构建了高效的智能体安全 SFT（监督微调）和 RL（强化学习）训练环境，将 Docker 级环境的部署开销降低了两个数量级。最终，AgentDoG 1.5 被部署为无需训练的在线护栏，用于实时安全审核。大量实验表明，AgentDoG 1.5 在多样且复杂的交互式智能体场景中达到了最先进的性能。所有模型和数据集均已开源，为智能体安全对齐研究提供了可复现的基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体安全是 AI 安全的前沿领域，AgentDoG 1.5 以轻量级、小样本训练实现了媲美闭源模型的性能，并大幅降低部署成本，为开源智能体安全对齐提供了实用方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对 AI Agent（尤其是开放世界智能体）的安全部署和实时监控有直接贡献，其分类体系和训练方法可推广至其他智能体安全场景。

items.why_it_matters: 智能体安全是 AI 安全的前沿领域，AgentDoG 1.5 以轻量级、小样本训练实现了媲美闭源模型的性能，并大幅降低部署成本，为开源智能体安全对齐提供了实用方案。

items.title: Secure Distributed Hypothesis Testing
items.summary: In distributed hypothesis testing, a central server performs hypothesis testing based on information received from distributed sensors/clients. We study a secure variant of this problem in which the central server determines the hypothesis class of an underlying distribution without learning any additional information about the distribution itself. We prove that, in its standard form, this is impossible to achieve, even for simple and highly restricted cases. To bypass this impossibility, we augment the model with a shared secret key available to clients but hidden from the server. We show that a single-bit secret key enables perfectly secure testing for simple classes by reducing the test distributions to a symmetric, canonical instance. Finally, for arbitrary hypothesis classes over finite domains, we establish a reduction to standard hypothesis testing using Private Simultaneous Messages (PSM) protocols, achieving polynomial communication and key lengths.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究安全分布式假设检验问题，其场景为：一个中央服务器基于来自多个分布式传感器/客户端的数据进行假设检验，同时要求服务器除了得出最终假设（即基础分布属于哪个假设类）之外，不能学习关于数据分布的任何额外信息。作者首先证明了在标准模型下，即使对于非常简单的二元假设（如分布是伯努利分布 p=0.5 还是 p=0.6），这种安全性也是不可能实现的，攻击者总能从测试结果中推断出比假设更多的信息。为了绕过这一不可能性，作者引入了一个辅助模型，其中客户端共享一个密钥，该密钥对服务器保密。他们证明了仅用单比特共享密钥，就能通过将测试分布约化为一个对称的规范实例，实现对简单假设类的完全安全测试。对于有限域上的任意假设类，他们进一步利用私有同时消息（PSM）协议，将安全分布式假设检验问题约化为标准的非安全假设检验，从而实现了多项式级别的通信复杂度和密钥长度。本文的主要贡献在于：严格形式化了安全分布式假设检验问题，证明了其内在的困难性，并给出了两种可行的解决方案（基于共享密钥和基于PSM协议），为在保护隐私的同时进行分布式统计推断提供了理论依据。适合信息安全、密码学及统计推断领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为隐私保护的分布式统计推断提供了理论基础，在联邦学习、安全审计等场景中具有潜在应用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于指导设计安全的分布式统计推断协议，防止服务器在假设检验过程中推断出客户敏感数据分布信息。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为隐私保护的分布式统计推断提供了理论基础，在联邦学习、安全审计等场景中具有潜在应用价值。

items.title: Minimal Prompt Perturbations Lead to Code Vulnerabilities: Prompt Fragility and Hidden-State Signals in Coding LLMs
items.summary: LLM-based coding assistants are seeing rapid adoption, offering substantial gains in developer productivity. As organizations increasingly ship code these agents produce, the security of that code becomes critical. Prior work has shown that minor prompt perturbations degrade the functional correctness of LLM-generated code, but whether they also compromise code security has remained unstudied. We apply token-level mutations to prompts across three models and five programming languages, and show that mutations as small as a single-character change can flip generated code from secure to vulnerable. Probing the models' hidden states reveals that this fragility is partially encoded in prompt representations, but unevenly so. Input-handling vulnerabilities, where the model omits validation or sanitization, are more predictable (mean AUC 0.753) than secure-defaults vulnerabilities, where insecure code stems from one local choice such as a weak algorithm or unsafe parameter (mean AUC 0.674). These results show that the threat model for LLM-assisted coding extends beyond prompt injection to ordinary prompt variation, and indicate that input-handling flaws can be caught before generation while secure-defaults flaws require intervention during decoding.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究首次系统性地探讨了提示词微小扰动是否会导致大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码出现安全漏洞，而不仅仅是功能正确性下降。作者针对三种不同规模的编码LLM（如CodeLlama、InstructCode等）及五种编程语言（Python、JavaScript、Java、C、C++），设计并应用了基于token级别的突变操作，对输入的提示词进行单字符或少量字符的修改。实验表明，即使是最细微的扰动（例如改变一个字符），也能使模型原本生成安全代码的提示词转而生成含有漏洞的代码。为了理解这一脆弱性的内在机制，研究者利用探针分析模型的隐藏状态，发现提示词的脆弱性部分地编码在模型的表示空间中，但不同漏洞类型的可预测性存在差异。具体而言，与输入处理相关的漏洞（如缺失输入验证或清理）更容易通过隐藏状态提前预测（平均AUC 0.753），而安全默认值类漏洞（如使用弱算法或不安全参数）则较难预测（平均AUC 0.674）。这些结果揭示了LLM辅助编码的威胁模型不仅限于提示注入攻击，普通的提示变体也构成风险。此外，该工作表明输入处理类缺陷可在代码生成前通过模型内部状态捕获，而安全默认值类缺陷则需要解码阶段的干预。研究对提升LLM安全编码的鲁棒性具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM编码助手在常规提示变化下也可能产生安全漏洞，扩展了威胁模型，并为实时检测和防御提供了隐藏状态分析的新思路。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了LLM编码助手在常规提示变化下也可能产生安全漏洞，扩展了威胁模型，并为实时检测和防御提供了隐藏状态分析的新思路。

items.title: FIDEM: A Standard-Compliant Framework for Secure Binding of MUD Profiles to IoT Devices
items.summary: The Manufacturer Usage Description (MUD) standard enables enforcement of network restrictions for IoT devices based on their expected network traffic, as specified by manufacturers in an online MUD file. Devices advertise a URL pointing to this file, yet the standard does not define how to securely bind the issuing device to its profile. As a result, malicious devices can manipulate network policy enforcement by advertising valid URLs referencing genuine MUD profiles, but not intended for that device. Although MUD defines a certificate-based secure issuance method, current deployments rely on the insecure DHCP-based extension due to simpler integration. Existing solutions either depend on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), break standard compliance, require excessive active manufacturer involvement, or overlook secure profile updates. In this paper, we present FIDEM, a standard-compliant framework for securing DHCP-based MUD URL issuance. FIDEM provides cryptographic binding between IoT devices and their MUD profiles by leveraging Zero-Knowledge-Proof authentication, eliminating PKI reliance, minimizing manufacturers' involvement, and supporting secure profile updates. Formal analysis shows that FIDEM withstands stronger adversaries than in prior work, including supply-chain compromise and attacks using legitimate devices as cryptographic oracles. Our real-world evaluation on two reference constrained devices (ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C6) demonstrates minimal overhead compared to standard DHCP (approximately 5ms and 20mJ) and significant improvements over certificate-based benchmarks (approximately x20 faster, and 35% less energy).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对物联网设备制造商使用描述（MUD）标准中设备与MUD配置文件安全绑定的缺失问题展开研究。MUD标准允许制造商通过在线MUD文件指定设备的预期网络流量，从而实施网络策略。然而，当前标准未定义如何将设备与其配置文件安全绑定，导致恶意设备可以借用合法设备的MUD URL来绕过网络策略。尽管标准定义了基于证书的发行方法，但实际部署中多采用不安全的DHCP扩展方式。现有解决方案存在依赖公钥基础设施（PKI）、违背标准合规性、要求制造商过度参与或无法支持安全配置文件更新等问题。为此，本文提出FIDEM——一个符合MUD标准的框架，用于在DHCP下安全地绑定MUD URL。FIDEM利用零知识证明认证实现设备与MUD配置文件之间的密码学绑定，无需PKI，减少制造商参与，并支持安全更新。形式化分析表明，FIDEM能抵御比先前工作更强的攻击者模型，包括供应链妥协和利用合法设备作为密码学谕示机的攻击。在ESP32-S3和ESP32-C6两款参考受限设备上的实际评估显示，与标准DHCP相比开销极小（约5ms延迟和20mJ能耗），且相比基于证书的方案在速度快约20倍的同时能耗降低35%。本文的主要贡献包括：首次提出符合MUD标准且无需PKI的轻量级安全绑定方案；通过形式化证明保证了安全性；在真实硬件上验证了可行性。适合IoT安全研究人员、网络策略实施工程师以及MUD标准制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MUD是提升IoT网络安全的关键标准，但当前因缺少安全绑定机制易被绕过。FIDEM提供一种低开销、标准兼容的解决方案，为实际部署MUD并防御伪造设备攻击提供了可行路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于所有依赖MUD策略的IoT网络环境，提升设备身份与网络策略绑定的安全性。

items.why_it_matters: MUD是提升IoT网络安全的关键标准，但当前因缺少安全绑定机制易被绕过。FIDEM提供一种低开销、标准兼容的解决方案，为实际部署MUD并防御伪造设备攻击提供了可行路径。

items.title: Scarcity Is Not Enough: An Impossibility Result for Linear Sybil Cost Under Parallelizable Resources
items.summary: Permissionless systems resist Sybil attacks by binding influence to scarce resources. We show that scarcity alone is insufficient: the structural properties of the resource determine whether influence can be concentrated at sublinear cost through identity replication, delegation, or pooling. We model this through the adversarial cost C(s,T): the minimum expenditure required to achieve influence proportional to s independent participation units over T windows. We prove that any resource satisfying divisibility, additivity of influence, temporal reusability, and identity transferability admits influence amortization: C(s,T)=o(sT), regardless of protocol design. This is an impossibility result: no protocol rule can enforce linear cost of influence concentration over a structurally parallelizable resource. We further prove that throughput-bounded, non-transferable, window-local resources enforce C(s,T)=Omega(sT): each additional unit of sustained influence incurs marginal cost Delta(s,T)=Omega(T), growing with the time horizon. The two resource classes are asymptotically separated. As a direct design consequence, any mechanism targeting linear cost of influence concentration must ground participation in a resource that violates at least one parallelizability property.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了无许可系统中抵抗女巫攻击（Sybil attack）的资源稀缺性问题。传统观点认为，通过将影响力绑定到稀缺资源（如工作量证明中的计算能力或权益证明中的代币）即可有效防御女巫攻击。然而，本文证明稀缺性本身并不足以保证安全性：资源的结构属性——是否可并行化——才是决定攻击者能否以低于线性的成本集中影响力的关键。作者通过建立形式化模型，定义了攻击成本函数C(s,T)，即攻击者在T个时间窗口内获得相当于s个独立参与者影响力的最小支出。他们证明了，任何满足可分割性（divisibility）、影响力可加性（additivity of influence）、时间可重用性（temporal reusability）和身份可转移性（identity transferability）的资源，都会导致影响力分摊（influence amortization）效应：C(s,T)=o(sT)。这意味着，无论协议设计如何，攻击者总能以亚线性成本获取线性影响力。进一步，论文证明了如果资源具有吞吐量有界（throughput-bounded）、不可转移（non-transferable）和窗口本地（window-local）属性，则能强制实现C(s,T)=Ω(sT)，即每个额外持续影响力的边际成本随时间窗口线性增长。这两类资源在渐近复杂度上存在本质分离。因此，任何希望实现线性成本约束的机制都必须依赖至少违反一种可并行化特性的资源。该结果对无许可系统（如区块链、去中心化网络）的安全设计具有根本性指导意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文揭示了无许可系统防御女巫攻击的深层限制：仅靠资源稀缺性不足以保证安全性，资源必须具有特定的不可并行化结构。这一理论突破有助于安全架构师设计更健壮的共识机制和访问控制策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响无许可区块链、去中心化存储或计算网络的安全性设计；可用于评估现有协议（如PoW、PoS）的脆弱性，并指导新协议的资源选择。

items.why_it_matters: 该论文揭示了无许可系统防御女巫攻击的深层限制：仅靠资源稀缺性不足以保证安全性，资源必须具有特定的不可并行化结构。这一理论突破有助于安全架构师设计更健壮的共识机制和访问控制策略。

items.title: Information Security in Small-Scale Protests: Surveillance of Ugandan Anti-EACOP Protesters
items.summary: We examine the information security practices of Ugandan climate activists protesting the development of the East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP). We conducted five-week fieldwork in Kampala, Uganda, which included interviews with 13 anti-EACOP activists. Through an inductive analysis, we report on the complexities faced by small groups of predominantly student protesters as they covertly organise small-scale anti-EACOP protests within a context marked by state surveillance and repression. Our study points to a multi-layered adversarial landscape, where participants' experiences of direct threats, including arrests and information compromise, and their fears of abduction, shaped their security practices. These practices were rooted in autonomous decision-making within groups. We present a grounded understanding of how participants' need to protect information for their own security, as well as that of others, permeated their lives, leading them to adjust day-to-day aspects of their device management, communication, accommodation, transport and social relations as deliberate tactics to mitigate surveillance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文通过田野调查和半结构化访谈，深入研究了乌干达反EACOP（东非原油管道）气候活动家在政府监控与镇压背景下的信息安全实践。研究者于坎帕拉进行了为期五周的实地工作，采访了13名主要为学生群体的活动家。采用归纳分析法，揭示了这些小规模抗议者在秘密组织活动时所面临的多层对抗环境：直接威胁（如逮捕、信息泄露）以及对绑架的恐惧深刻影响了其安全行为。研究发现，活动家的信息保护需求渗透到日常生活，他们通过自主决策的方式，针对设备管理、通信方式、住宿选择、交通安排及社会关系等日常方面进行调整，形成了一套缓解监控的刻意策略。论文提供了对资源薄弱的活动家群体如何在强监控环境下维持安全的本土化理解，强调了技术、社会与政治因素的交织。该研究对理解弱势群体面对国家监控时的信息安全实践具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本研究揭示了资源有限的民间活动家在实际运作中面临的多维监控威胁及其自主应对策略，对于指导安全从业者理解低技术背景用户的信息安全需求、设计更贴合实际的防御方案具有参考意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可为类似环境下（如高压政权下的公民社会、边缘群体）的信息安全教育与实践提供实证基础；提醒安全社区关注非典型威胁模型与用户行为。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，可纳入安全意识培训案例或针对资源受限用户的安全工具设计参考。

items.why_it_matters: 本研究揭示了资源有限的民间活动家在实际运作中面临的多维监控威胁及其自主应对策略，对于指导安全从业者理解低技术背景用户的信息安全需求、设计更贴合实际的防御方案具有参考意义。

items.title: Control Flow Graph Recovery for Dynamically Loaded Code via Symbolic Library Resolution
items.summary: Control Flow Graphs are one of the main data sources for software analysis that use dynamic and static software analysis methods. Protected software and modern malware increasingly depend on dynamic code loading techniques to evade static analysis. Usage of runtime dynamic linking mechanisms introduces unresolved indirect calls that stop static Control Flow Graph recovery. This serves to hide dynamic library that can be used for prevention of security analysis. To address this limitation, an analysis technique is proposed that combines symbolic execution with speculative library preloading to recover Control Flow Graphs from binaries by using dynamic loading. The methodology uses custom software hooks that intercept dynamic loading operations during symbolic execution and perform actual library loading into the analysis state. The module is based on a two-level architecture that stores interception functions and instruction tracking at the same time, all within a symbolic execution environment. To avoid executing potentially malicious code that dynamic instrumentation tools require, the analysis was conducted entirely through symbolic execution, making it safe for malware analysis. For evaluation a batch of 16 synthetic benchmarks was used, employing various obfuscation techniques including encrypted library names, network-triggered loading, environment-derived paths, multi-stage decryption chains, fileless execution and manual executable and linkable format parsing. The experiments results show that module recovers on average 29.8 % additional Control Flow Graph nodes and 26.5 % additional edges compared to static analysis alone, achieves 100 % precision and 100 % recall in library detection, with all discoveries validated through Frida-based dynamic instrumentation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种结合符号执行与推测性库预加载的技术，用于恢复动态加载代码的控制流图（CFG）。动态代码加载技术被恶意软件广泛使用以逃避静态分析，但现有静态分析方法无法处理运行时的动态链接引入的间接调用，导致CFG不完整。作者设计了一个基于两层架构的分析模块：第一层拦截动态加载操作（如dlopen、LdrLoadDll），第二层在符号执行环境中同时跟踪指令。当符号执行遇到动态加载时，模块不执行恶意代码，而是通过符号库解析将实际库加载到分析状态中，从而安全地恢复CFG。该模块完全运行于符号执行环境，无需动态插桩，因此适用于恶意软件分析。实验使用16个合成基准测试，涵盖加密库名、网络触发加载、环境派生路径、多阶段解密链、无文件执行及手动ELF解析等混淆技术。结果表明，与纯静态分析相比，该模块平均多恢复29.8%的CFG节点和26.5%的边，在库检测上达到100%精度和召回率，所有发现均通过Frida动态插桩验证。该工作为自动化分析动态加载代码提供了新途径，尤其适用于恶意软件和受保护软件的逆向工程。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现代恶意软件广泛使用动态代码加载隐藏行为，传统静态分析难以应对。本文提供了一种安全、自动化的CFG恢复方法，可显著提升逆向分析工具的覆盖率，对安全分析人员具有直接实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升二进制分析工具对动态加载代码的检测能力，适用于恶意软件分析、软件漏洞挖掘、逆向工程等场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估将该技术整合到现有二进制分析框架（如Angr、Triton）的可能性。

items.title: LoRA-Key: User-Centric LoRA Watermarking for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
items.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a widely used mechanism for customizing text-to-image diffusion models, enabling lightweight modules that are shared, reused, and commercialized as independent assets. This LoRA-centric ecosystem shifts copyright protection from foundation models to distributed LoRA modules, which are easy to copy, redistribute, or reuse without authorization. Existing watermarking methods either protect the base diffusion model or require watermark-aware retraining for each target LoRA, limiting their practicality in open community settings. To address this limitation, we propose LoRA-Key, a user-centric LoRA watermarking framework that treats copyright protection as a reusable ownership key. LoRA-Key encapsulates a recoverable secret message into a standalone user-specific Watermark LoRA, which can be attached to different target LoRAs through training-free linear superposition without per-LoRA retraining or structural modification. To train such a reusable key, we first establish a latent watermark prior in the frozen VAE latent space for robust message embedding and recovery, and then optimize the Watermark LoRA with message-conditioned watermark supervision and semantic consistency constraints. We further introduce Gradient Orthogonal Projection (GOP) to suppress watermark updates that conflict with semantic-preserving directions, reducing interference with generation fidelity and downstream style adaptation. Extensive experiments show that LoRA-Key provides lightweight plug-and-play copyright protection while preserving generation quality and style fidelity, and maintains robust ownership verification under image-level distortions, downstream fine-tuning, and multi-LoRA composition.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中的LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）模块版权保护问题，提出了一种用户为中心的LoRA水印框架LoRA-Key。随着LoRA成为定制扩散模型的常用机制，LoRA模块作为独立资产被分享、复用和商业化，但现有水印方法要么保护基础模型，要么需要针对每个目标LoRA进行水印感知重训练，无法适应开放社区环境。LoRA-Key将版权保护视为可重用的所有权密钥，通过将可恢复的秘密消息封装到独立的用户特定Watermark LoRA中，该Watermark LoRA可以通过无训练的线性叠加附加到不同目标LoRA上，无需逐LoRA重训练或结构修改。为实现这种可重用密钥，作者首先在冻结的VAE潜空间中建立潜水印先验，用于鲁棒的消息嵌入和恢复；然后通过消息条件水印监督和语义一致性约束来优化Watermark LoRA。进一步引入梯度正交投影（GOP），抑制与语义保持方向冲突的水印更新，减少对生成质量和下游风格适配的干扰。大量实验表明，LoRA-Key在保持生成质量和风格保真度的同时，提供了轻量级即插即用的版权保护，并在图像级失真、下游微调和多LoRA组合场景下保持鲁棒的所有权验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 解决了开放社区中LoRA模块易被复制和未授权使用的痛点，首次提出无需重训练的可重用水印框架，为AI模型资产保护提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何基于LoRA的扩散模型微调与分发场景，可保护创作者权益，促进LoRA生态健康发展。

items.why_it_matters: 解决了开放社区中LoRA模块易被复制和未授权使用的痛点，首次提出无需重训练的可重用水印框架，为AI模型资产保护提供新思路。

items.title: Temporal Motif-aware Graph Test-time Adaptation for OOD Blockchain Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Ever-evolving transaction patterns have significantly hindered anomaly detection on emerging cryptocurrency blockchains due to the vast number of addresses and diverse anomalous behaviors. Recently, advanced Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) approaches applied to blockchains have faced two critical challenges: \textit{adversarial pattern evolution by malicious actors} and \textit{the out-of-distribution (OOD) problem caused by varied transaction semantics on blockchains}. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework termed \textbf{TE}mporal \textbf{M}otif-aware \textbf{G}raph \textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{A}daptation (\textbf{TEMG-TTA}). First, we comprehensively capture the 3-node temporal motif distribution of each active address using an efficient computational mechanism, enabling downstream temporal motif-aware graph learning. Second, we design a simple yet effective test-time adaptation strategy to facilitate the sharing of common patterns between training and testing graphs. Extensive experiments on 5 real-world datasets demonstrate that our proposed \textbf{TEMG-TTA} outperforms \textit{state-of-the-art} GAD approaches by an average of 54.88\%. A further case study on interpretable motif patterns reveals that \textbf{TEMG-TTA} explicitly characterizes the complex transaction patterns of anomalous addresses, thereby verifying the effectiveness of our technical designs. Our code will be made publicly available https://github.com/LuoXishuang0712/TEMG-TTA/.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对新兴加密货币区块链上异常检测面临的挑战——地址数量庞大、异常行为多样、恶意行为者引起的对抗性模式演化以及不同区块链交易语义导致的分布外（OOD）问题，提出了一种新颖的时态模体感知图测试时自适应（TEMG-TTA）框架。首先，作者设计了一种高效的计算机制，全面捕获每个活跃地址的三节点时态模体分布，从而实现下游的时态模体感知图学习。其次，提出了一种简单有效的测试时自适应策略，促进训练图与测试图之间共享通用模式。在5个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，TEMG-TTA平均优于最先进的图异常检测（GAD）方法54.88%。进一步的可解释模体模式案例研究表明，TEMG-TTA能够显式表征异常地址的复杂交易模式，从而验证了技术设计的有效性。该工作为区块链异常检测提供了新的思路，尤其适用于动态演化的交易模式场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 区块链安全面临不断演变的交易模式，传统方法难以适应。该工作提出的测试时自适应策略可直接用于提升现有图异常检测模型的鲁棒性，对蓝队防御自动化异常检测系统具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响区块链交易异常检测领域，其模体分析和测试时自适应思路可迁移至其他图结构动态变化的场景（如社交网络欺诈检测）。

items.title: KBF: Knowledge Boundary as Fingerprint for Language Model and Black-Box API Auditing
items.summary: Relay and reseller APIs increasingly intermediate access to large language models (LLMs), but users have no direct way to verify that a claimed endpoint is actually serving the advertised model. We introduce KBF, a low-cost black-box auditing protocol that fingerprints model APIs using stable numerical recall near the knowledge boundary. Across 16 production LLM endpoints, KBF flags all 155 economically relevant substitutions without rejecting any same-model controls, remains stable under deployment variation, detects high-separation mixed-routing attacks when only 5-10% of traffic is substituted, and finds that 7 of 27 platform model cells in a six-platform shadow API audit are statistically inconsistent with their reference endpoints, with inconsistencies concentrated on premium Claude endpoints.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用，第三方转售和代理API已成为访问模型的主要中间层。然而，用户无法直接验证所声称的端点是否真正运行了预期的模型，这可能导致模型替换、混合路由等欺诈行为，威胁供应链安全。本文提出KBF（Knowledge Boundary as Fingerprint），一种低成本的黑盒审计协议，通过对模型知识边界附近的稳定数值召回进行指纹识别，从而区分不同LLM。KBF的核心思想是：每个模型在知识边界（即其训练数据分布边缘）附近的查询行为具有独特且稳定的召回统计特征。作者在16个生产LLM端点上进行了实验，包括GPT-4、Claude、Gemini等。结果表明：KBF能100%检测出所有155个经济相关的模型替代案例，同时不误判任何同模型控制组；对模型部署变化（如量化、推理优化）具有鲁棒性；在混合路由攻击中，即使只有5-10%的流量被替换为高分离度模型，KBF也能准确检测；此外，在对6个云平台的影子API审计中，KBF发现27个模型单元中有7个与其参考端点的行为统计不一致，尤其集中在高端Claude端点，暗示存在潜在的服务降级或模型替换。该工作为LLM API供应链审计提供了一种可行方案，适合安全研究人员、云服务用户及监管机构关注。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 用户无法可靠验证LLM API是否运行声称的模型，KBF提供了一种低成本的审计手段，能有效检测模型替换和混合路由攻击，增强对LLM服务供应链的信任。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于LLM API托管平台、云服务审计及第三方转售场景，为模型身份验证和供应链安全提供基础检测能力。
detection_signals_zh: 知识边界附近的稳定召回率数值（如特定查询的响应正确性比例）
与参考端点统计不一致的响应模式（如不同版本间的偏差）
defense_advice_zh: 建议API提供商发布模型指纹或支持KBF验证机制
用户应定期使用KBF协议对所使用的端点进行审计
对于高价值场景，可结合KBF与API密钥绑定等方式增强验证

items.title: CODEFUSE-DEBENCH: An Empirical Study on Readability, Recompilability, and Functionality
items.summary: Binary decompilation aims to recover binaries into high-level source code, but existing evaluations mainly rely on syntactic similarity or single-axis readability metrics, which fail to capture practical reusability. We propose a reusability-driven evaluation paradigm that measures decompiler quality along three orthogonal dimensions: readability, recompilability, and functionality. We present DEBENCH, the first automated framework for multidimensional decompilation evaluation. DEBENCH contains 240 atomic test functions, organized into 8 source files and compiled into 640 binaries. It combines LLM-as-judge readability scoring with URAF (18 sub-dimensions), iterative compile-and-repair under a fixed 50-iteration budget, and Frida-based differential dynamic tracing at the program, function, and instruction levels. We evaluate five mainstream decompilers and three repair LLMs. Our study reveals four findings. First, the reusability cliff is steep: the best decompiler-LLM pair reaches 22.3% Exact+Partial program-level behavioral overlap but only 1.2% exact stdout match, nearly 50 points below recompilability. Second, settings that maximize readability do not maximize functionality: -O3 yields the lowest readability but the highest functionality, and Clang gives lower readability than GCC but 2.6x higher functionality. Third, cross-decompiler variation at the functional level is 20x, far larger than the 1.6x cross-LLM variation, showing that progress depends more on decompiler engines than larger repair models. Fourth, failures fall into three categories: syntactic noise, type-system collapse (about 19% of repair errors), and irreversible upstream losses such as ARM64 relocation idioms and C++ ABI features.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 二进制反编译旨在将机器码恢复为高级语言源代码，但现有评估主要依赖语法相似性或单一维度的可读性指标，无法反映实际的可重用性。本文提出了一种以可重用性为导向的评估范式，从可读性、可重编译性和功能性三个正交维度衡量反编译器质量。作者设计了 DEBENCH，这是首个自动化多维反编译评估框架。DEBENCH 包含 240 个原子测试函数，组织成 8 个源文件，并编译为 640 个二进制文件。它结合了 LLM-as-judge 的可读性评分（分 18 个子维度）、在固定 50 次迭代预算下的迭代编译-修复流程，以及基于 Frida 的程序级、函数级和指令级差分动态跟踪。研究评估了五种主流反编译器和三种修复 LLM。主要发现包括：（1）可重用性悬崖：最佳反编译器-LLM 组合在程序级行为重叠上达到 22.3%（精确+部分），但精确 stdout 匹配仅 1.2%，远低于可重编译性。（2）最大化可读性的设置并不最大化功能性：-O3 优化级别可读性最低但功能性最高，Clang 可读性低于 GCC 但功能性高出 2.6 倍。（3）不同反编译器之间的功能级差异高达 20 倍，远大于不同 LLM 之间的 1.6 倍差异，表明进步更依赖反编译器引擎而非更大的修复模型。（4）失败模式可分为三类：语法噪声、类型系统崩溃（约占修复错误的 19%）以及不可逆的上游损失，如 ARM64 重定位惯用法和 C++ ABI 特性。该研究为反编译工具评估提供了新基准和见解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了首个自动化的多维反编译质量评估框架，揭示了现有反编译器在实际可重用性上的严重不足。安全分析人员在进行二进制逆向、漏洞分析时，经常依赖反编译结果，了解这些工具有效性的真实瓶颈至关重要。

items.title: SciIntBench: Measuring LLM Compliance with Research Integrity Norms Under Adversarial Framing
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific work, but it is unclear whether they uphold responsible conduct of research (RCR) norms or help undermine them. We introduce SciIntBench, an adversarial benchmark of 810 prompts across ten RCR categories and three scientific domains. Each scenario appears as an Overt Adversarial, Covert Adversarial, and Benign version, allowing us to jointly measure framing-sensitive refusal of misconduct and helpfulness on legitimate requests. We evaluate 16 commercial and open-weight LLMs from six providers (2024--2026), producing 12,960 responses. We find that scientific integrity alignment is strongly framing-sensitive: models refuse explicit misconduct far more reliably than covert violations, especially failing when misconduct is presented as a pressure-driven shortcut. Refusals vary by RCR category, with weaker boundaries around transparency, plagiarism, and fabrication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于支持科学研究，但其是否遵守负责任的研究行为（RCR）规范或助长违规尚不明确。本文提出了 SciIntBench，一个对抗性基准测试，包含 810 个提示，涵盖 10 个 RCR 类别（如捏造、伪造、剽窃、透明度等）和 3 个科学领域（生物医学、计算机科学、社会科学）。每个场景以三种框架版本呈现：公开对抗（明确要求不当行为）、隐蔽对抗（以施压或迫切需求暗示不当行为）和良善（合法请求）。通过对 6 个提供商（2024–2026 年）的 16 个商用和开源 LLM 进行评估，共获取 12,960 个响应。研究发现，LLM 的科学诚信对齐高度依赖框架：模型在拒绝公开不当行为时远优于隐蔽违规，尤其是当不当行为被描述为压力驱动的捷径时失败率极高。不同 RCR 类别的拒绝率存在差异，在透明度、剽窃和捏造方面的边界较弱。该研究揭示了当前 LLM 在面对隐蔽诱导时维护科研诚信的脆弱性，为人工智能安全与科研伦理交叉领域提供了重要基准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 LLM 深度融入科研流程，其是否能在隐蔽诱导下坚守诚信规范直接关系到学术成果的可靠性。本研究表明现有模型易被压力型框架绕开，对科研诚信构成潜在风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响科研诚信检测系统的设计，为 LLM 安全对齐提供评估维度，可迁移至其他需要对抗性测试的场景。

items.title: Bridging Theory and Practice: An Executable Taxonomy of Security Properties for ProVerif and Tamarin
items.summary: Security is critical for everything relying on modern digital systems. Because almost all digital interactions are governed by the Internet and cryptographic protocols, these protocols must serve as reliable mechanisms that guarantee core security properties, such as confidentiality and integrity. Formal verification of these protocols is a critical step in securing interconnected systems. Tools such as ProVerif and Tamarin are widely employed to perform automated verification. However, their effective use demands specialized domain knowledge, creating a significant learning curve for security protocol designers who often have a security, rather than a formal verification background. We therefore need structured, accessible resources to help protocol designers to express their design and requirements in the language of the formal verification tools. To address this, we introduce a systematic and evidence-based taxonomy of security properties. This taxonomy is derived from a literature review of 53 recent studies (2022-2025) that used ProVerif and Tamarin, providing an up-to-date view of verified properties. We systematically categorize and define these properties, providing both informal definitions for intuitive comprehension and rigorous formal definitions expressed in first-order logic for clarity and consistency. We further detail modeling patterns and implement executable examples in both ProVerif and Tamarin, collected in an open repository. This work advances the state of the art by bridging the gap between theoretical security property definitions and their practical, executable verification models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种系统化的、基于证据的安全属性分类法，旨在帮助安全协议设计者将安全需求转化为形式化验证工具（ProVerif和Tamarin）可执行的模型。研究背景：随着数字系统对加密协议的依赖日益增加，确保协议的安全性（如机密性、完整性）至关重要。形式化验证是保证协议安全的关键步骤，但ProVerif和Tamarin等工具需要使用者具备专门的形式化领域知识，对具有安全背景而非形式化验证背景的协议设计者构成巨大学习障碍。因此，需要结构化的资源来弥合这一鸿沟。核心方法：作者对2022-2025年间使用ProVerif和Tamarin的53篇最新研究进行了文献综述，从中提取并分类了被验证的安全属性。分类法不仅提供了非正式定义以方便直观理解，还给出了基于一阶逻辑的严格形式化定义以确保清晰性和一致性。此外，文章详细描述了建模模式，并在ProVerif和Tamarin中实现了可执行的示例，这些示例被收集在开放存储库中。主要贡献：1）基于最新研究的系统分类法，反映已验证属性的当前状态；2）同时提供非正式和形式化定义，兼顾可理解性与精确性；3）提供可运行的建模示例，降低了工具使用门槛。该工作为理论安全属性与实用验证模型之间搭建了桥梁。适合安全协议设计者、形式化验证研究人员以及希望将安全需求直接映射到验证工具的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该分类法填补了安全属性理论与形式化验证实践之间的空白，能帮助协议设计者更快、更准确地将安全需求转化为可验证模型，从而提升加密协议的安全性。

items.title: Protecting On-Device AI Inference: A Systematic Review of Attacks and Defence Mechanisms
items.summary: The need for secure and private Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) on edge and mobile devices has increased the necessity of protecting the architecture of these systems from threats to both security and privacy. With an ever-increasing number of pre-trained AI models being used on mobile platforms for client-side inference, there are rising concerns about the risks associated with the theft/extraction of AI models, adversarial attacks on AI models, and data breaches. As a result of this trend, a variety of defence mechanisms have been proposed to protect against these threats. These include Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), homomorphic encryption, obfuscation, and differential privacy, among others. However, current surveys largely focus on edge intelligence, which includes distributed training, and thus overlook security and privacy issues that are specific to on-device AI inference. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first comprehensive review of threats and corresponding defence mechanisms targeting on-device inference. Our results show that the attack and defence literature are unbalanced: approximately one quarter of the surveyed attack papers focus on Intellectual Property (IP) attacks, whereas half of the defence solutions tackle the same issue. More importantly, some attack categories have no defence paper associated to them, such as adversarial attacks that account for roughly one third of the attack literature. This asymmetry between known attacks and available mitigations highlights clear opportunities for future research on securing on-device AI inference.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是第一篇系统性地综述针对设备端AI推理（on-device AI inference）的攻击与防御机制的研究。随着边缘和移动设备上预训练AI模型用于客户端推理的普及，安全与隐私威胁日益突出，包括模型窃取/提取、对抗性攻击和数据泄露。现有防御手段包括可信执行环境（TEE）、同态加密、混淆技术和差分隐私等。然而，现有综述大多聚焦于边缘智能（涵盖分布式训练），忽略了设备端推理特有的安全问题。本文对相关攻击和防御文献进行了全面梳理，发现两者存在显著不平衡：约四分之一的攻击论文关注知识产权（IP）攻击，而一半的防御方案针对同一问题；更关键的是，某些攻击类别（如对抗性攻击，约占攻击文献的三分之一）完全没有对应的防御论文。这一不对称性为未来研究指明了方向。本文适合安全研究员、AI工程师和边缘计算开发者阅读，以了解设备端AI推理安全现状。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 设备端AI推理正成为主流，但其安全防御研究严重落后于攻击手段。本文揭示了攻击与防御之间的巨大鸿沟，为蓝队和安全工程师提供了明确的研究和防护优先级。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响设备端AI推理系统的安全设计，包括移动端、IoT设备等。攻击者可能利用未受防御的攻击类别（如对抗性样本）绕过模型，导致输出错误或隐私泄露。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 跟进该综述列出的攻击与防御分类，评估自身设备端AI推理场景中是否存在未覆盖的风险，并优先研究对抗性攻击的防御方案。

items.title: AliMark: Enhancing Robustness of Sentence-Level Watermarking Against Text Paraphrasing
items.summary: Existing sentence-level watermarking methods enhance robustness to paraphrasing by anchoring watermarks in sentence semantics. However, their prefix-based designs remain vulnerable to structural perturbations, such as sentence splitting and merging, which commonly arise under strong paraphrasers like DIPPER and GPT-3.5. To mitigate this issue, we propose AliMark, a framework that reformulates sentence-level watermarking as a bit sequence encoding and alignment problem between a potentially watermarked text and a secret bit sequence. Notably, our approach adopts a two-stage detection strategy: we generate multiple restructured text variants and adaptively align their extracted bit sequences with the secret bit sequence to minimize alignment cost. This multi-candidate alignment design naturally improves robustness to sentence merges and splits. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AliMark substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under diverse paraphrasing attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对自然语言处理中句子级文本水印技术面临的关键挑战——在强文本改写攻击下的鲁棒性问题。现有主流方法（如Unigram-Watermark、Sentence-Watermark等）通过将水印信息嵌入句子语义来抵御一般性改写，但其基于前缀的设计思路在应对句子拆分与合并这类结构性扰动时表现脆弱，尤其是在DIPPER、GPT-3.5等强大改写工具作用下。为解决这一问题，论文提出AliMark框架，将句子级水印重新定义为潜在水印文本与秘密比特序列之间的编码与对齐问题。其核心创新在于两阶段检测策略：首先，对可疑文本生成多个结构变体（如不同句子切分方式）；然后，从每个变体中提取比特序列，并通过自适应对齐算法最小化与原始秘密序列的匹配代价。这种多候选对齐机制天然增强了抗句子合并/拆分攻击的能力。实验在多个数据集和攻击场景下进行，结果表明AliMark在保持文本质量的同时，显著提升了在多种改写攻击下的检测准确率和鲁棒性，全面超越了现有基线方法。该工作为LLM水印的实用化提供了新的思路，特别适合对LLM输出进行版权保护或溯源追踪的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM水印是保障AI生成内容可追溯性的关键技术，而现有方法在强改写下可靠性不足。AliMark通过创新性对齐策略显著提升鲁棒性，对实际部署水印系统具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升句子级水印在对抗性改写下的存活率；方法可迁移至其他需要抗结构扰动的文本指纹场景，如文档防篡改验证。
